none: PAS CAM-6B5BE5: Roman Coin : A Copper-alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine: VRBS ROMA, AD330-331
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine: VRBS ROMA, AD330-331 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads - . Reverse shows She wolf and twins, two stars above wolfs back. Mint is Trier. See RIC, VIII, p214, no 524. Obverse legend reads: VRBS ROMA. Obverseshows Helmeted bust facing left. Reverse fields and exergue reads: -// TRP. Die axis: 6 o'clock
